result-synthesizer.name: Result Synthesizer
result-synthesizer.description: Completion agents synthesize findings into structured decisions + evidence before messaging core/human. Prevents raw working state from being dumped to the user.
result-synthesizer.rationale: Borrowed from Claude Code coordinator synthesis rule: coordinators must distill worker findings into concrete decisions with evidence, never forward raw output. Scoped to completion_agents -> core only.
implementation_options: Prompt-level: inject synthesis instructions into completion agent prompts
Post-hook: run summarization pass on outgoing core-bound messages
Hybrid: prompt instructs synthesis format, post-hook validates structure

synthesize-results.name: Synthesize Results
synthesize-results.description: When a completion_agent sends a message to core/core, transform raw working state into structured output: decisions made, evidence, files changed, open questions

synthesis-hook.name: Synthesis Hook
synthesis-hook.description: Post-hook on completion_agent messages to core that validates or enforces synthesis format. Runs after agent writes message but before it reaches core injector.

synthesis-prompt.name: Synthesis Prompt Section
synthesis-prompt.description: Prompt section injected into completion_agent system prompts instructing structured result synthesis with format: summary, decisions, evidence, files changed, open questions.

synthesis-format.description: Completion agent messages to core must follow structured format: (1) Summary - 1-3 sentence outcome, (2) Decisions - what was decided and why, (3) Evidence - file paths, test results, specific findings, (4) Changes - files created/modified with brief descriptions, (5) Open Questions - unresolved items requiring human input

dispatcher.description: Worker dispatcher handles message routing and hook execution

prompt-sections.description: Prompt section builders for agent system prompts

consumer.description: Message consumer routes messages between agents and core
